title: Set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
description: Download Microsoft Authenticator on your mobile device and register your corporate identity via https://aka.ms/mfasetup.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Enroll Laptop in Microsoft Intune MDM
description: Verify disk encryption (BitLocker/FileVault) and install corporate endpoint security within 48 hours of receipt.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Attend Virtual Welcome Orientation
description: Join the company-wide welcome session with People Operations to understand our mission, values, and organizational structure.

title: Review Employee Policies & Code of Conduct
description: Review global standards of business conduct, anti-harassment, and leave policies in the employee portal.
reference_doc: Standards of Business Conduct & Ethics Policy

title: Review Health, Dental & Benefits Elections
description: Submit your healthcare plan elections, retirement contributions, and designate beneficiaries in the HR portal.

title: Set up development environment
description: Install Docker, Python/Node runtime, VS Code/IDE extensions, and configure local containerized microservices.

title: Get repository/Git access
description: Join corporate GitHub / Azure DevOps organization, generate Ed25519 SSH keys, and configure GPG commit signing.

title: Configure required APIs/tools
description: Request API tokens for staging environments, Redis, PostgreSQL, and cloud service development sandboxes.

title: Complete security training
description: Complete secure coding guidelines module, OWASP top 10 review, and secrets management best practices.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Review backend architecture/documentation
description: Study the system architecture diagrams, API contracts, database schemas, and service-to-service communication specs.

title: Meet engineering mentor/team
description: Schedule 1-on-1 intro sessions with your technical buddy, team lead, and engineering peers to review sprint workflows.

title: Complete role-specific technical tasks
description: Pick a starter backlog issue, submit your first pull request to staging, and walk through code review with your buddy.

title: Set up CRM access
description: Request and configure Salesforce / Dynamics 365 CRM credentials, territory mapping, and sales dialer integration.

title: Complete sales/product training
description: Watch core product pitch walkthroughs, competitor battlecards, and complete the sales qualification quiz.

title: Review pricing and sales documentation
description: Familiarize yourself with enterprise licensing tiers, discount approval matrices, and master services agreement (MSA) templates.

title: Meet sales manager
description: Conduct 1-on-1 target alignment with your Sales Director to review quarterly quotas, accounts, and commission structures.

title: Learn lead-management process
description: Review marketing qualified lead (MQL) handover criteria, SLA response times, and opportunity stage progression rules.

title: Complete first customer/sales workflow task
description: Shadow two enterprise customer executive calls and draft your first mock pitch deck with feedback from sales leadership.

title: Get HR system access
description: Provision administrative credentials for Workday HRIS, Greenhouse ATS, and benefits administration portals.

title: Review employee policies
description: Perform a deep dive into leave policies, disciplinary guidelines, remote-work stipends, and compensation bands.

title: Learn HR workflows
description: Shadow the weekly new joinee induction process, offboarding checklist execution, and employee issue ticket queues.

title: Complete compliance-related training
description: Complete regulatory training on employee data privacy (GDPR / Indian DPDP Act / HIPAA) and fair employment practices.
reference_doc: Standards of Business Conduct & Ethics Policy

title: Meet HR team
description: Meet Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and HR Business Partner teams to establish cross-functional alignment.

title: Schedule Customer Discovery Shadowing
description: Shadow at least two enterprise customer syncs or sales demos with the Account Executive team.

title: Publish First PRD / Feature Specification Draft
description: Draft product requirements for upcoming sprint milestone and share with engineering leads.

title: Office access & badge setup
description: Visit the reception desk at Delhi DLF CyberCity facility to register biometric access and collect your NFC smart badge.

title: Location-specific facilities information
description: Review Delhi office amenities, cafeteria timings, parking slot allotment, emergency exits, and medical room protocols.

title: Local IT setup
description: Meet Delhi campus IT helpdesk for desk monitor connection, Wi-Fi cert provisioning, and local printer setup.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Office orientation
description: Attend the Delhi office floor walkthrough and team lunch hosted by the local workplace facilities team.

title: Collect Redmond Campus Security Badge & Parking Pass
description: Visit Building 92 Security Office to pick up your NFC badge and register vehicle with campus transportation.

title: Redmond Campus Transit & Facility Pass
description: Activate ORCA transit card and review Connector shuttle schedules for commuting to the campus.

title: Complete UK Pension Auto-Enrollment & NHS Verification
description: Confirm National Insurance details, NHS healthcare coverage, and pension contribution in the UK HR portal.

title: London Office Badge & TFL Commuter Benefit
description: Pick up your Paddington office access pass and enroll in the Transport for London corporate cycle-to-work scheme.

title: Remote-work setup
description: Set up your home ergonomic workstation, high-speed internet connection, and claim your $1,200 home office equipment stipend.

title: VPN/access configuration
description: Configure corporate GlobalProtect / Azure VPN client and verify secure zero-trust gateway connectivity for internal tools.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Remote security requirements
description: Review remote work security protocols: clean desk policy, screen privacy filters, and secure home Wi-Fi encryption.
reference_doc: IT Security, Hardware Provisioning & Remote Access Guide

title: Virtual orientation
description: Schedule 1-on-1 virtual coffee check-ins with your manager and team members via Microsoft Teams.
